tools.name: search_screens
tools.description: Search Mobbin for UI screens using natural language. Returns matching screens with inline images and metadata. Examine the returned images to understand each screen's actual content — do not describe or summarize screens based solely on metadata. Each screen has a `mobbin_url` — the canonical Mobbin link for that screen. When you present results to the user, ALWAYS cite each screen you mention as a markdown link to its `mobbin_url` so the user can open it on Mobbin. On hosts that support MCP Apps, also renders an interactive gallery of the results.

query.description: Describe one screen in plain language — the UI elements you'd see and how they relate. Be specific; detail helps. Good: "login screen with biometric authentication", "checkout page with promo code field and Apple Pay button". Avoid: combining multiple screens/intents (search separately), negations ("without ads"), vague style words ("modern", "clean"), disconnected keyword lists. Name a specific app to filter results to it (e.g. "Spotify now-playing screen"). Do not include platform (ios/web) — use the dedicated parameter.

mode.description: Search mode. "standard" returns results with low latency. "deep" uses an AI-powered pipeline that interprets intent and scores results for relevance — ideal for nuanced queries. "fast" is a deprecated alias for "standard" and will be removed in a future version — use "standard" instead.

exclude_screen_ids.description: Screen IDs to exclude from results

limit.description: Maximum number of screens to return. Higher number of screens returned causes increased context usage.

image_format.description: Image format. Use jpg if your client does not support webp.

query.description: The natural language query used for this search.

image_url.description: Image URL for the screen. Expires after 30 days.

mobbin_url.description: Link to view this screen on Mobbin.

app_name.description: Name of the app this screen belongs to.

tools.name: search_flows
tools.description: Search Mobbin for multi-step user flows (e.g. onboarding, checkout) using natural language. Returns evenly-spaced preview images inline along with metadata for each flow, including per-screen previews. Examine the returned images to understand each flow's actual content — do not describe screens based solely on metadata. On hosts that support MCP Apps, also renders an interactive gallery of the results.

query.description: Describe one user journey in plain language — the steps and what you'd see along the way. Be specific; detail helps. Good: "onboarding with personalization steps", "checkout with payment method selection". Avoid: combining multiple flows (search separately), negations, vague style words, disconnected keyword lists. Name a specific app to filter results to it (e.g. "Duolingo onboarding"). Do not include platform (ios/web) — use the dedicated parameter.

limit.description: Maximum number of flows to return. Lower limits are recommended to manage context size.

page.description: Page number for paginating through results. Maximum 20.

image_format.description: Image format. Use jpg if your client does not support webp.

query.description: The natural language query used for this search.

has_next_page.description: Whether more pages of results are available.

actions.description: Flow action labels associated with this flow.

mobbin_url.description: Link to view this flow on Mobbin.

app_name.description: Name of the app this flow belongs to.

screen_count.description: Number of screens in this flow.

image_url.description: Image URL for the screen. Expires after 30 days.

position.description: 1-based position of the screen in the flow.

tools.name: search_sections
tools.description: Search Mobbin for website sections (e.g. About, Pricing, Footer) using natural language. Returns section images inline along with metadata. Examine the returned images to understand each section's actual content — do not describe or summarize sections based solely on metadata. On hosts that support MCP Apps, also renders an interactive gallery of the results.

query.description: Describe one website section in plain language — the content and elements you'd see. Be specific; detail helps. Good: "pricing page with plan comparison table", "hero section with signup form". Avoid: combining multiple sections (search separately), negations, vague style words, disconnected keyword lists.

limit.description: Maximum number of sections to return. Higher number of sections returned causes increased context usage.

page.description: Page number for paginating through results.

image_format.description: Image format. Use jpg if your client does not support webp.

query.description: The natural language query used for this search.

page.description: 1-based page number of this batch of search results.

has_next_page.description: Whether more pages of results are available.

image_url.description: Image URL for the section. Expires after 30 days.

mobbin_url.description: Link to view this section on Mobbin.

site_name.description: Name of the site this section belongs to.
